The fighting there is pretty hairy.''"
"''Republic forces have engaged the Separatists, but at this point it's anyone's game.|[[Trick]] and Bennic Halloren|}} Despite the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Battle of Lessu|victory]] in the [[Battle of Ryloth]] in [[21 BBY]], heavy '''fighting''' would continue to plague the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems. ==Prelude== {{Main|Battle of Ryloth}} The [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] was [[Invasion of Ryloth|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' in [[22 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' during the [[Clone Wars]], beginning the long-lasting [[Battle of Ryloth]]. The initial invasion saw the destruction of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s defending [[Outer Rim garrison]]{{TCW|Supply Lines}} and establishment of the [[Twi'lek Resistance]] under [[Cham Syndulla]], who continued to wage a guerilla campaign against the occupying [[Separatist Droid Army]].{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} In [[21 BBY]], the Republic marshalled its forces for an effort to liberate Ryloth{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} and [[Battle of Lessu|succeeded]] by allying with Syndulla's rebels. Afterward, a [[Republic Military]] presence was established on Ryloth for its protection,''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' although Syndulla had already expressed a fear to [[Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu]] that his troops would become just another occupying [[army]] he would need to fight. Around 21 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Lessu|end]] of the [[Battle of Ryloth]] to [[21 BBY]]. Meanwhile, it also dates the [[wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso]] to [[25 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' then establishes that the [[Erso family|Ersos]] moved to [[Vallt]] three [[Standard year|years]] later, and ''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' establishes that their rescue occurred after they spent one year on Vallt. Therefore, the [[Vallt Rescue Operation|rescue of the Erso family]] also occurred in 21 BBY. As the [[defeat at Ryloth]] occurred around the same time as the rescue, it must have occurred around 21 BBY. Ryloth was the site of a [[Defeat at Ryloth|Republic defeat]] that came to the attention of [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]] and [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]]. Combined with the [[losses at Bothawui]], the defeat caused Amedda to press Krennic on how he would recruit the [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso]] into Republic service.''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' ==The fighting== Despite the end of the Battle of Ryloth in 21 BBY, the world, ultimately, had become the site of renewed fighting as of [[19 BBY]]. The fighting was heavy and so dangerous that Republic [[intelligence officer]] [[Bennic Halloren]] feared the world might fall to the Confederacy once again. [[Clone Captain]] [[Howzer]], a veteran of the original Battle of Ryloth who took pride in having come to Ryloth to free it from Separatist control,{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}} remained stationed on the world for many months and helped to defend the [[Twi'lek]] people against Separatist attacks. Over his deployment, he grew close with General Syndulla.{{TBB|Devil's Deal}} ==Aftermath== The end of the Clone Wars and rise of the [[Galactic Empire]] would see the formation of the [[Ryloth Insurgency]] to free the planet from the Empire. Howzer was stationed on Ryloth at the start of the insurgency but came to reject the Empire, rallying much of his [[Howzer's squad|squad]] against the regime in the process by asking them if they still recognized the government. ==Behind the scenes== The concept of post-Battle of Ryloth fighting for Ryloth was first implied by the [[2016]] novel ''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' by [[James Luceno]]. The book features a mention of a Republic "defeat at Ryloth" around 21 BBY, specifically in a time period that would have already seen the end of the original battle earlier in 21 BBY. As the novel does not outright discuss the nature of this battle, this article does not presently assume if it was part of the Clone Wars. The concept was again eluded to in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article "[[The Best of the Batch]]," which establishes Clone Captain Howzer, who had first arrived on Ryloth to free the world from the original battle, spent many months on Ryloth defending the world from the Confederacy, actions which would have to come after his arrival. Finally, this renewed fighting for Ryloth was outright depicted in the [[2026]] video game ''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'', the events of which begin in 19 BBY, long after the 21 BBY-concluded Battle of Ryloth. Therefore, this article assumes a renewed "fighting" for Ryloth began at some stage after the original battle. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|216|The Best of the Batch}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ryloth, fighting on}} [[Category:Battles of Ryloth]] [[Category:Campaigns in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Campaigns of the Clone Wars]]
